name: Acceptance stream A
description: The acceptance run's streams fixture (§5.4 "Streams"): a plugin whose host half streams generated bytes to its own page and the page streams generated bytes back, each end reporting the count and a checksum; and whose host half reads a stream another plugin's point handler (acceptance-stream-b) answers with. Its sidebar app button's component mounts in a frame of its own layer as soon as it runs.

commands.name: report
commands.description: What its page and its host half counted of each stream.

commands.name: down
commands.description: Streams generated bytes from its host half to its page; the host half's count and checksum.

commands.name: up
commands.description: Has its page stream generated bytes to its host half; the host half's count and checksum of what it read.

commands.name: point
commands.description: Reads the stream acceptance-stream-b's point handler answers with; the host half's count and checksum.
